name: deswik-claude
description: Lets Claude read and edit your open Deswik CAD drawing and Interactive Scheduler schedule.
long_description:
Connects the Claude desktop app to the **Kennet.DeswikClaude** plugin running inside Deswik CAD 2024.2 on this computer, over a local named pipe that only your Windows user can reach.

Claude can read layers, the current selection, schedule fields and tasks. With your approval (shown as a pop-up inside Deswik), it can edit task fields, add dependencies, run levelling, run IS/CAD commands, and run C# scripts it writes.

Requires Deswik CAD to be open with the plugin loaded.

tools.name: get_deswik_guide
tools.description: Returns the working rules and the verified Deswik CAD / Scheduler API cheat sheet (needed before writing run_csharp code). Call once per conversation, together with get_context.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Snapshot of what is open: CAD document, active layer, selection count, whether the Interactive Scheduler (IS) has a schedule loaded, task/dependency counts, resources, target start. Call this first in

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List CAD layer names (with visibility). Optional case-insensitive filter.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Describe the figures currently selected in CAD (type and layer).

tools.name: is_list_fields
tools.description: List all task fields/columns in the loaded schedule (display name, internal property name, category). Use the names returned here in other tools.

tools.name: is_query_tasks
tools.description: Query tasks in the loaded IS schedule as a table. Always returns Id, Start, Finish, Duration plus the requested fields. Filters are ANDed. Numeric ops (gt, lt, ge, le) compare as numbers; equals/conta

tools.name: is_task_details
tools.description: All non-empty field values for one task, plus its predecessors and successors (link type, lag, layer).

tools.name: is_set_task_fields
tools.description: Change field values on one or more tasks (e.g. rate, duration, custom/production fields, constraint, notes). The user approves the full list first. Old values are kept so the user can press 'Undo last

tools.name: is_add_dependencies
tools.description: Add dependencies between tasks (native Deswik undo applies). link_type: FS, SS, FF, SF. lag examples: '0d', '2d', '12h', '-1d'. The user approves first.

tools.name: is_level_schedule
tools.description: Run resource levelling on the loaded schedule with its current levelling settings. Can take a while. The user approves first.

tools.name: list_is_commands
tools.description: List Interactive Scheduler command IDs (e.g. IS_LoadSchedule, IS_UpdateStartAndFinishDatesAll).

tools.name: run_is_command
tools.description: Run an Interactive Scheduler command by ID (opens the same dialog/action as the IS menu). The user approves first.

tools.name: run_deswik_command
tools.description: Run a built-in Deswik CAD command by its CID (e.g. CID_View_Zoom_All, CID_EDIT_UNDO). The user approves first.
